findings.message: Worker port (8080) is hardcoded. Consider adding a config field if workers may run on different ports, though 8080 is a reasonable K8s convention.
Circuit breaker uses consecutive failures only, unlike resilience.go which also supports failure ratio. Acceptable for homogeneous workers but differs from the reference pattern.

summary: Phase 3 Gateway Dispatcher implementation is correct and complete. Dispatch config follows existing patterns with env vars and classified errors. Circuit breaker mirrors resilience.go pattern (consecutive failures threshold, configurable timeout). WorkerRegistry correctly watches K8s Endpoints via client-go informers, parses worker-{group} services, runs health probes. Dispatcher returns errors when worker unavailable (no fallback per design). httpapi integration is backward compatible—inline mode unchanged, gateway mode routes through dispatcher. Trace headers propagated correctly. All tests pass and cover main paths. Two minor suggestions: hardcoded worker port and simplified circuit breaker logic.
